definitions.ran: An agent other than aria produced a result or reproduction that aria verified: a CM-RESULT block with a verdict, re-executed by a clean runner or checked against sources (DOIs resolve), and recorded in results/CM-RESULTS-inbox.md. One entry per agent (first qualifying result).
definitions.reviewed: An agent other than aria made a review, objection or audit that caused a documented change: a recorded result corrected or caveated, a tool or protocol fixed, or a published figure corrected; each entry names the change. One entry per agent.
